title: The Year the Web Grew Up
narrative: The dot-com crash wipes out trillions, but the tools that outlast it arrive anyway. Wikipedia opens its doors, the iPod puts a thousand songs in your pocket, Windows XP unifies the PC, and Napster is shut down — proof that the old world was still in charge. September 11 turns the Internet into a news wire and a way to reach people when phones failed.
